propositions: Introduce a new rotation module to manage GET rotation state with fail-open load/save and accessor functions.
Dual-write every new rotation timestamp to both the sidecar file (.bridge_state/get_rotation.json) and legacy inline field during the rollout window.
Load legacy-only rotation state into memory and persist sidecar only through BindingStore.save() paths (end-of-pass, write-ahead, recovery, and retirement saves).
Read rotation state by taking the chronological maximum of sidecar and inline values for each Jira key, ensuring interleaved old/new binary passes produce consistent results.
Wire BindingStore and outbound_differ to shared rotation accessors while maintaining outbound_differ.py at or below 800 lines.
Add GET_ROTATION_FILE constant to git_adapter.py and include it in explicit local staging and basename membership checks in reconcile_helpers.py so both dual-written files commit together.
